steps.name: Create database benchmark
steps.note: Creates dept, orders, and ledger. Nothing is assumed to exist.

steps.name: insert orders
steps.op:
db.orders.insertMany(documents, batches of 500)
{ sku, dept, job, sal, qty, note, bonus on every 10th }

steps.name: updateOne sku 1
steps.op: db.orders.updateOne({ sku: 1 }, { $set: { note: "clerk keeps the amended ledger 1" } })

steps.name: transaction commit
transaction abort
create text view orders_search
steps.op: { create: "orders_search", viewOn: "orders", pipeline: [], kova: { inverted: true, analyzer: "en_stem" } }

steps.name: mapReduce orders
steps.op: { mapReduce: "orders", query: { dept: 1 }, map: { key: "$job", value: "$sal" } }

steps.name: aggregate lookup dept
steps.op: db.orders.aggregate([{ $match: { sku: { $gt: 0, $lt: 101 } } }, { $lookup: { from: "dept", localField: "dept", foreignField: "dept", as: "department" } }])

steps.name: SELECT sku, first pass
steps.op:
SELECT sku, job, sal FROM orders WHERE sku = n
n = 1..100

steps.name: SELECT sku, second pass
steps.op:
SELECT sku, job, sal FROM orders WHERE sku = n
n = 1..100

steps.name: SELECT sal > 2000
steps.op: SELECT sku, job, sal FROM orders WHERE sal > 2000

steps.name: SELECT COUNT and GROUP BY job
steps.op: SELECT job, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(sal) AS payroll FROM orders GROUP BY job

steps.name: SELECT COUNT(*)
steps.op: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders

steps.name: INNER JOIN dept
steps.op: SELECT a.sku, b.name FROM orders a INNER JOIN dept b ON a.dept = b.dept

steps.name: WHERE TEXT clerk
steps.op: SELECT sku, job, sal FROM orders_search WHERE TEXT 'clerk'

steps.name: WHERE TEXT clrek FUZZY 0.3
steps.op: SELECT sku, job, sal FROM orders_search WHERE TEXT 'clrek' FUZZY 0.3

steps.name: FACETS job and sal
steps.op: SELECT facet, bucket, doc_count FROM orders_search WHERE TEXT 'clerk' FACETS job TERMS, sal RANGES (1500), (1500, 3000), (3000)

steps.name: Update one row with SQL
steps.op: UPDATE orders SET qty = 1 WHERE sku = 1

steps.name: Update many rows with SQL
steps.op: UPDATE orders SET bonus = 7 WHERE qty = 7
